a-cunning-decoy:
On behalf of Avalon Shipping, we are requesting the services of a daring band of mercenaries.

We deal in shipping and transportation of goods and materials across one of the largest logistics networks within House Davion territory. Unfortunately, this leads to unwanted attention of criminal syndicates and even pirates. We are moving an exceptionally large shipment across this particularly troubled area, and require aid to ensure that we do not fall victim to larceny.         

We will leak false information that our convoys are passing through a pair of star systems. In reality, we will take a completely different JumpShip route. We want you to lie in wait in these two decoy systems, where you will draw away the pirates' attention and cause as much damage as you can. If there are bounties on these pirates, they will be yours to claim.

a-dragon-in-sheep-s-clothing:
FIELD COMMUNICATION: OMEGA SECURITY: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

The International Security Force—the Draconis Combine's intelligence service—has been monitoring secret meetings between the Great Houses of Steiner and Davion. While we are unsure of the full nature of these meetings, we cannot allow any formal alliance to solidify between our two border enemies.

Should you choose to accept it, your first mission is to spoil relations between these two Houses by raiding a Steiner outpost while masquerading as a House Davion detachment.

FIELD COMMUNICATION: OMEGA SECURITY: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

The Dragon is pleased with your work. After you destroyed the base, we uncovered additional transmissions regarding clandestine Davion envoys traveling into Steiner space. You are to cause a distraction on the target world so our personnel can hack into the Lyrans' comms relay in hopes of discerning what the Davion envoy is planning.

The distraction we have in mind involves striking a warehouse complex. Several large ice-mining hauls destined for shipment to water-poor worlds are awaiting pickup there, and another Arcturan Guards battalion is stationed on the premises. Striking this facility will create a distraction that will upset that entire region long enough to let our agents accomplish their mission undetected.

FIELD COMMUNICATION: OMEGA SECURITY: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

We have broken the encoding on the intercepted transmissions and have verified the location of the neutral site where the Steiner and Davion envoys are meeting. In the name of the Dragon, you will eliminate the House Davion delegation while operating under House Steiner colors.

We've arranged for you to arrive in the target system as merchants. It will give you a chance to drop right on the heads of the Davion envoys and their security detail. Utterly destroy them, and dash any hopes of a lasting Steiner-Davion alliance. Our enemies cannot be allowed to unite.
adam-steiner:
Jake,

The Kommandant just informed me that this simple supply run isn’t simple at all. It appears someone else has their eyes on the goods on Barcelona’s shelves. Scans show a heavy presence of Clan Steel Viper in the system.  He just spoke to the planetary governor; these Clan raiders arrived in the system a short time ago and have been pestering them, issuing batchalls for their food reserves and duels. Truce or not, these Clanners are intent on making life miserable for citizens across the Inner Sphere.

Now we’re in a spot. The Kommandant spent a solid two weeks fighting against the Clanners to secure this planet. He doesn’t want to just abandon the world after all that work. He’s intent on driving these Viper raiders out. He’s already identified supply caches belonging to the Vipers, likely their war stores brought along for their raid. He believes we can kill two birds with one stone by ridding the planet of the Clan presence, and scoring enough supplies to last us the entire trip.  

The plan is to hit their supply stores and send them packing. But you know the Clanners won’t just give up their property without serious pushback.I’m sure you already know what I’m about to say: that’s where you come in. Steiner is assembling a raiding party to hit the ground and recover the Viper supplies by force. He’s asked you to join him on the ground to strengthen his hand. He may not be royalty, but he sure barks orders like one. But I need to remind you you're here to protect IE's interests; we can't get sucked into a drawn out affair with Vipers and risk our assets. We need to get those supplies and clear out. But if the Steel Vipers don't vacate Barcelona after we secure the assets, Steiner might cause a few headaches. But we'll cross that bridge if we come to it. Kommandant Steiner will provide you with the drop coordinates shortly.

We need those supplies, Jake. If we venture into the blind empty-handed, the success of this entire operation will be at risk.

Jake,

I hope your machines aren't too banged up. I know these Clanners always put you through the ringer out there, but based on the after action report, you're holding your own. That is good news, because nothing is in the bag just yet. I stressed to the Kommandant that it’s vital that we don't leave a single piece of materiel or consumable behind before the trip to Cambridge. For once, I'd love for these Clanners to go quietly, but I should know by now that they weren't bred to make our lives easier. Additional salvage crews have been dispatched to round up all the provisions to try and speed up the process. Steiner's confident that once we strip the Steel Vipers of their supplies, they’ll pack up and leave.
 
Alright, Jake. I need you to gear up and help Steiner keep the Steel Vipers off the backs of the salvage crews long enough to recover all of the supplies. If you wanted some extra incentive, just remember that the trip to Cambridge will be a slow burn; empty your tanks on these Vipers and finish up. Then you'll have a few months to kick back and rest up.  Okay: time is of the essence. Steiner's forces are ready to deploy; and he needs all hands on deck. Go help keep the occupational hazards to those salvage crews under control.

Jake,

I know you didn’t sign up for this type of fight, but I’ve seen you rise to the occasion before. I know you’ll come through now. I know this will be easier said than done, but just remember: your old man was a Clanner. It’s in your blood to slay these demons. If you’re able to gut this out, I’ll make sure Kommandant Steiner provides a fat bonus for your troubles. IE won’t forget your contributions either, especially if we’re able to pull through this and the AFFC snatches up what I’m selling.

But I don’t want to speak too soon, we’ve still got a trial to win here. Kommandant Steiner was just informed of the details of this trial of possession, but it’s not much to go on. She’s withholding the exact coordinates of the starting ground, but they were able to sneak a recon satellite into the region for a quick sweep. They just detected Jade Falcon signatures in a sector, so he’s ready to hit the ground and start throwing some punches. He’s assigning you to do some of the heavy lifting early on. You’ll need to clear a safe LZ for the Kommandant and his forces to land. I know the asks are piling up here, Jake, but you always manage to work your way out of tight jams. You know I like being right, so don’t prove me wrong now.

The Kommandant’s counting on you to get things rolling. Go shoot some green birds and make it happen.

Commander Mason,

I may not have heard of your outfit before we shared the battlefield in Barcelona, but since then, you’ve been providing me with a live scouting report, and I’m damn glad to have you on my side during this trial. I know going head-to-head with the Jade Falcons wasn’t in the deal you signed, but you all have performed like real pros so far. We’re going to need more of that to weather this storm.

Redmond’s done us no favors heading into this contest: the true size of their force is still a mystery to us. We need to have a better idea of what we’re up against, or we’ll risk them waiting us out and mopping us up with their reserves.

I know the Jade Falcons; I’ve fought them many times. Honor dictates that if we hit the field, Redmond will throw out her cadets to test their mettle.

I’m assigning you as the advance scouting party, Commander. See if you can shake enough trees for the Falcons to move off their perch so we can get a solid headcount. Then I can formulate a plan for us to win this thing.

Ready yourselves, Commander. Let’s find out how many Falcons we’re dealing with here.

Commander,

I don’t want to get ahead of myself, but if Redmond hasn’t hit the panic button yet, she’s got her hand hovering over it. We’ve chewed up and spit out the cadets she’s thrown at us, and they’ve been training under her. If the goal was to put what she’s taught them on display on the battlefield, they’re not great examples of Clan superiority.

But I know a fight against the Jade Falcons isn’t over until it’s over, and Redmond’s bringing out her big guns now. During the battle lull, she sent me a transmission promising our demise is around the corner. She’s prepared to send out her collection of battle-hardened academy instructors to try to sway this battle in their favor.

Facing off against untested cadets is one thing, but we’re about to slug it out against another tier of warrior. We all need to up our game heading into this next scrap.

Let’s keep grinding them down, Commander. We need to hit them so hard the ghost of Kerensky will feel it. Then maybe they’ll throw in the towel.

I’ll see you on the ground.

Commander,

Now that we’ve cleared up the picture enough to know how many warriors Redmond is willing to sacrifice to beat us, we can try to whittle them down. It’s clear that Redmond is using this trial as an opportunity for her cadets to hone their skills against us; to harden them. I’d be flattered, but we’re in a life-and-death struggle, so the pride in knowing she thinks of us as a stiff enough test to blood her underlings will have to wait.

If Redmond wants us to keep testing her cadets’ skills, we’ll oblige. I’ve selected various target areas for different assault groups to hit, fast and furious. Use the Jade Falcon playbook against them.

Prep for combat. Redmond wants to blood her warriors, we’ll bloody them for her.

Well, it appears the biggest obstacle remaining between us and winning this trial is Nicolai Malthus. And I wouldn’t have it any other way. I battled Malthus across the Jade Falcon occupation zone many times. I turned beating his ass into a hobby. Not to mention I stole a bunch of Clan tech out from under his nose after he had taken me prisoner on Twycross… I think he’s still a little bitter. And since all of the humiliation he’s suffered by my hand doesn’t seem to have put a dent in his arrogance, we’ll be able to use that against him on the battlefield and put this trial to bed.

But make no mistake, Commander, we’re in for one hell of a fight. Malthus may be prone to getting in his own way, but he’s fueled by rage and revenge against me, so I know this isn’t going to be a picnic. We’re close to the finish line, Commander. We need to go through Nicolai Malthus to get there, so gear up and help me deliver the knockout punch. Time to smack Malthus around for old time sake.
an-intriguing-offer:
Although the mercenary creed runs counter to the bushido code of the Draconis Combine, the advantage of flexible morality cannot be ignored. Kurita warriors who espouse the bushido tenet of honorable combat would balk at a headhunting strike behind enemies lines to eliminate a commander, but most mercenaries harbor no such qualms.

The Crater Cobras mercenary outfit has anchored several Davion counterincursions into the Dieron Military District, attempting to stall our own advances. Cutting the head off the snake, so to speak, should allow our forces free rein to operate in Davion territory.
armed-robbery:
The local systems are in shambles. Many mercenary outfits are packing up and running, while others are looking to ransack vacant merc bases. It's never a bad idea to take advantage of an opportunity, and this might be it.. My clients need supplies too, and if you get your hands on some, I'll give you a healthy cut of the resale value. 

If you're game, I've got intel on a system where an independent company from Harlock's Warriors is trying to get out of the system for good. If you're not afraid to shoot at other ’Mechs, you should be able to chase them off and acquire some of their supplies. The surefire way to chase them off with minimal fuss is to shoot down the ’Mech of Anders Willman, their head of security, and then the rest of the outfit should scatter. Willman's not well liked, to say the least, so you'd essentially be doing the Warriors a favor, and with the occupants on their way out anyway, they shouldn’t put up that much of a fight to protect someone they'd rather be rid of.

After chasing off the Warriors, I'll send in my crews and pay you for anything that's on my list of necessaries. Anything else you find will be yours for the taking.
blood-minerals:
Greetings merc, we've got a delicate situation on our hands, and could use the services of... an outsider.

Our quarrel isn't with a rival house or militant insurrection. Instead, we're having issues with a mining collective known as the Obsidian Harvest Corporation. Years ago, Obsidian pensioned the protectionist Minister of Trade to provide the company with a parliament-backed exclusive mining contract on the world of Amity, in some of the harsh deserts along the planet's equatorial line. What everyone thought was a modest rare mineral patch tuned out to be one of the richest veins of rare earth minerals on Amity.

Their negotiated contract with the League was set at a fixed rate at fair market value. But the quality of the ore extracted from this site has drawn the attention of the Lyran Commonwealth. We have come to learn that Lyran traders offered Obsidian three times the market value to buy out Obsidian's full supply, in clear violation of their contract with parliament. Unfortunately, Obsidian's greed got the best of them. Not only have they be selling a majority of their haul to the Commonwealth, but they've been poorly attempting to hide their dealings with them from parliament.

This stands to be particularly embarrassing for the Minister of Trade given his political affiliation as a protectionist. Since the protectionists pride themselves as nationalists who heavily oppose international trade of any kind with antagonistic states like the Lyran Commonwealth, if news were to get out of this debacle, it stands to seriously hurt the protectionist agenda in parliament.

We have a plan to deal with Obsidian's flagrant disregard for their contract. But we do not wish to draw media attention as to why we are taking these actions. We want to do this quietly, without the press getting involved. Which is what we are hoping a mercenary of your reputation can assist us with.

We need you to blind a number of Obsidian owned communications arrays under the guise of a planetary raid. Make it look good and blind them to our true intentions to punish these traitors.

Good work in the raid, merc.

Due to some unforeseen circumstances however, we'll need to extend your contract— though that will of course mean more pay for yourself.

Obsidian Mining's board of directors is doing whatever they can to save themselves, and they're willing to drag us down with them. The board has threatened to publicly release documents showing that protectionist members of parliament personally brokered the Obsidian mining contract. It would be a disaster if this gets out, as the government would be accused of directly funding a mining company that is providing materials to its rivals. They've even contracted out a local mercenary battalion by the name of Homer's Hooligans to protect their board and the company's interests.

Obsidian Harvest wants us to back off in exchange for them staying quite. But let this be clear, the League will not be blackmailed by some two-bit mining corporation that got lucky with a single dig site. We've activated the Marik Militia stationed on Amity to help resolve this matter. We want you to link up with the Marik Militia and destroy all Obsidian-backed security forces that are protecting their board of directors.
bow-and-arrow:
Commander,

My father, Baron Kincaid of the Free Worlds League, who fought as a mercenary with your father long ago, has passed away. In one of his final requests, he has relinquished his claim over our family's Archer and has bequeathed the BattleMech to you. Unfortunately, the location of the 'Mech has been lost in time. However, I have discovered four possible locations from my father's notes. I want to fulfill my father's last wish to see his 'Mech, Agincourt, serve your mercenary company once again.

I have transmitted the locations to you. Though you should know that the coordinates were also sold on the black market by Bowen, my estranged brother. In the name of my father's memory, do not let Agincourt fall into the hands of rogues and treasure hunters. You must act quickly if you want to claim that which is rightfully yours.

Commander, after doing some digging I believe that the coordinates Bowen sold on the black market may have been fake. It seems like he is trying to make as much money as he can off of our dead father. At the same time he's creating chaos at the locations we have yet to investigate. Likely to provide cover for his own search for the 'Mech. Bowen already seems to be flooding the second location with accounts of a lost 'Mech found at coordinates that coincide with military installations. You must stop these signals to end the spread of misinformation that threatens the peace of the Ibstock system.

Commander, with Bowen's misinformation now no longer transmitting, if he wants to claim the 'Mech he will need to oppose us more directly. This could make him a more dangerous adversary as our search narrows down. The third location appears to be an abandoned garrison facility. Some automated turrets seem to be the only thing here, but I'm sure that this is the place. We need to move in and secure this location, but be aware that Bowen may move to confront you with his own forces. Be careful.

We are getting close. 

When my father retired, he left his Archer in storage at the facility we just searched. When the base was decommissioned, the Archer was moved to the final location we have in our list! We need to get to that last location fast! No doubt Bowen and the Waco Rangers have a head start moving on that location. We will need to force them out before they can lay claim to the 'Mech!
bowie-electronics: Hello enterprising Mercenary, I am contacting you to in the hopes that we may be able to secure your discreet employment on behalf of my client, the Alarion branch of the Bowie Electronics Company. As of two weeks ago, operatives who are highly suspected of working on behalf of the TharHes corporation managed a daring theft of several of the Battlemechs. Bowie uses those 'Mechs as testing platforms for various types of proprietary equipment and weapons in addition to a number of partially assembled weapon prototypes.  This represents a significant data breach and financial loss to my client. TharHes officially denies the use of these operatives, of course.  Regardless, the Board of Directors would like to send a similarly plausibly denied response back to TharHes. Included in this transmission are the locations of several workshops that the Security Intel division at Bowie has identified as being connected to the operatives and are believed to be conducting illegal reverse engineering of the stolen products. They want these workshops destroyed outright. Bowie Electronics will officially deny any affiliation with you or your actions, and is opting to pay you in secret. Your first payment will be laundered through a modern art auction we have prepared.

While you were busy taking on those workshops, the Bowie Electronics Security Intel Division has been able to identify a well defended industrial site that they believe the TharHes operatives had been using as a staging area to equip themselves before making their theft.  Though the site doesn’t appear officially to be associated with TharHes, Bowie Security Intel agents have found major links between this location and the operatives.  They believe this site to be merely a clever front.  Bowie Electronics would like this industrial site razed to the ground to prevent any further thefts.  As before, discretion is key.  Your payment this time will be funneled through multiple anonymous donations to one of our dummy charities (The Save the Branths Program).

The Bowie Electronics Board of Directors has asked me to relay how much they value the work you are doing for them, and how much they are enjoying watching the extreme frustration and suffering of these TharHes shell corps as their lackeys give holovid press conferences on the terrible “pirate activity” in the area.  Bowie has one more mission for you.  The Security Intel division has finally managed to track down the possible location of the stolen mechs.  They are not too particularly concerned about getting them back at this point, as the TharHes operatives have already had plenty of opportunity to extract most if not all of the relevant diagnostic data off the machines.  They do, however, wish to send a harsh message that stealing from Bowie Electronics carries dire consequences.  Your continued cooperation is appreciated. As for pay, your proceeds will be laundered through an illustrated children’s book deal (The Littlest Atlas). We've already hired an authentic hack of a kid's book illustrator.
bring-her-home: Commander, your reputation precedes you. Please do me the honor of meeting with me at the capital city of my humble domain. At the risk of sounding dramatic, I have a delicate and urgent matter of life and death to discuss, and I believe I need someone of your caliber. I promise, you will be handsomely rewarded for the successful completion of your task.

Thank you for saving me, Commander. I again apologize for not being able to meet with you in person but my injures will prevent me from traveling anytime soon.

Some time ago, I received a confidential briefing from the Ministry of Information, Intelligence, and Operations warning me that they had received reputable intelligence that pointed to a potential plot against my life and possibly the entire Raman system. They implored me to reinforce my security detail and be vigilant of any suspicious activity among my subjects. I reached out to you in hopes that you would be able to bolster my protective detail until the MIIO gave me the all clear.

Sadly, it appears I was not fast enough in employing your services. Shortly before you arrived in-system, my estate was attacked by an unknown force. I do not know who these people are, but they have captured a number of my personal staff and most importantly my daughter Samantha. They now seem to be reinforcing their hold on my estate and the surrounding territory appearing to have no intention of leaving.

Samantha's safety is paramount! She is my heir, and the only family I have left in this world! I have taken command of the Draconis March Militia stationed here on Raman and have prepared a counter offensive to drive these mystery raiders off of my lands. We believe that they have moved Samantha and my captured staff to a holding facility a few clicks away from my estate's grounds. I'm counting on you to secure the prisoners and a landing facility for the Draconis March Militia where we will launch a counter offensive to run down these bastards!

Don't let me down, Commander.

So here's the deal, Commander,

The tracker I dropped in their vehicle worked! Using house Cole's resources we've determined that they have fled to the Draconis Combine! House Cole can't deploy house forces to respond without risking all out war with House Kurita. But I can't risk them attacking my family again. We need to take the fight to them on our own! 

I'm sending you coordinates to a communications outpost that they appear to have recently set up. If you can take it out, we'll disrupt their operations and make it harder for them to carry out whatever it is they are planning. In the meantime, while they're distracted, I'll follow my planted tracker and investigate their operations and see if I can figure out what exactly they're up to.

Thanks for your help, Commander. While you were raiding that facility, I was able to uncover more details on this group that's been attacking us. I still don't know who they are, or who they're working for, but I was able to identify their base of operations even deeper in Combine space. Their base is stationed in a remote polar region of Reisling's Planet constantly plagued by extreme weather and far from any civilian population. This makes the base all but invisible to those that do not already know it's there. But I believe these same conditions make it vulnerable to attack. Using the same extreme weather as a shield, I believe we could advance on the base by 'Mech and remain undetected. 

With this, we can finally find our answers and put a stop to this mystery threat once and for all!
charity-case:
Inter-System Advocacy is a nongovernmental charity organization. We are human rights advocates who work all across the Inner Sphere. And with the war-torn worlds we sometimes are called to aid, we need to contract with mercenaries for that work.

A humanitarian-aid mission we sent into drought- and famine-stricken Kurita worlds near the Periphery has gone missing. Despite the aid crew being quite sizable, consisting of twelve volunteers, nurses, and doctors, their JumpShip disappeared and is long overdue for reporting in. We have received two reports of pirate activity near known bandit strongholds in the region where the vessel vanished, and while these may be false positives, they are the only clues we can pass on to you.

We would like to contract you to raid these pirate bases. Our salvage crews will be able to analyze any data you uncover, which will help determine what happened to our missing volunteers.

These bandits did not capture our aid workers. Intercepted comms messages relayed through the outlaw's bases reveal that local civilians captured our team because they discovered the planet's secret.

After the fall of the Star League and the start of the First Succession War, all of the warring Great Houses embraced total warfare. The continuous usage of nuclear, biological, and chemical weapons of mass destruction cleansed countless cities and killed untold millions. Entire worlds were rendered uninhabitable. Not until the end of the Second Succession War and moving into the Third Succession War, as the conflict stretched into centuries, did all of the Great Houses agree that such unfettered use of WMDs would leave conquerors nothing but dead planets to rule.

Unfortunately, the civilians on these worlds discovered a cache of chemical weapons and are threatening to use them against their rulers unless all punitive measures are lifted on the planet's populace. Our aid workers have been caught in the civilians' desperation. Although we sympathize with the hardships these people have been forced to suffer, we cannot allow our volunteers to die, and we of course cannot allow these chemical weapons to be used. Stop these people before the horrors of the early Succession Wars are visited on these worlds.
chasing-ghosts:
A decade ago, my eldest son, Ravid, was an envoy on a diplomatic voyage to the Magistracy of Canopus, and the JumpShip he was on mis-jumped and never arrived at its destination. For ten long years he has been missing, and I have exhausted every resource to find him, or to at least discover what happened to him. I refuse to believe that he is dead, but it has been ten years without contact, so I can only assume the worst.

However, just when I was about to finally give up hope, I received a message from a Capellan merchant whose vessel had recently passed through the region in which my son's JumpShip disappeared. This merchant detected signs of habitation from a planet previously thought to be uninhabited, but he did not investigate due to the constant worry of stumbling into an unknown pirate den.

Could the crew and passengers of my son's ship have found a place of refuge, where they had no means of finding their way back home? Possibly. This is might be a wild goose chase, but I would be remiss to not follow through with trying to bring my son home. If you investigate and find my son, I will be forever in your debt. However, if you find criminals or other undesirables, I will ensure you are compensated for keeping the Free Worlds League safe from such predators.

competitive-edge: I'll just get to the point, Mercenary.  We've just learned that one of our competitors is arranging for one of our facilities to have a 'setback'.  I won't bore you with the details of what this would mean for our upcoming quarter but that this would be a significant blow.  We need you on-site as soon as you are able, and ready to protect our facility from hostile interests.

After the debacle at our facility on Arc-Royal, it's clear we underestimated our competition.  For now, we'd like to retain your services for another operation.  Here is a list of our competitor's warehouses on Zanderij.  We would like you to travel there, and ensure their destruction.  Expect resistance, likely the same mercenaries posing as 'outlaws' as before. This should buy us some time as we regroup and think about our next steps.
corporate-interests:
I am contacting you anonymously so that you understand the full repercussions of your recent military activities. I work for Quicksell, Inc., but I will tender my resignation when this situation is resolved because I learned that my company, contacting you under the guise of "concerned citizens of the Free Worlds League," hired you to destabilize this region. This whole affair arose due to Quickscell's profits plummeting due to the continued rise of the Earthwerks conglomerate within the Free Worlds League. In an effort to bring our competitor low while hopefully opening the region to our own military-hardware offerings, Quickscell hired you to wage low-grade strikes against Earthwerks-affiliated properties. In response to your attacks, Quickscell has already received a massive influx of defense contracts from several worlds in the region. Because of this, my company has likely already reached out to you with an offer to stage an additional attack that will further increase the region's demand for Quickscell-branded military hardware.

I cannot in good conscience allow Quickscell's ruse to continue because it is causing innocents to needlessly suffer. The people that your actions have hurt thus far, along with a collection of businesspeople and aristocrats, have banded together and will front a modest reward if you choose to betray Quickscell and serve justice to those the corporation's greed has hurt.

Should you agree to help us, you will attack the local Quickscell corporate offices to repay them for their dishonest business practices. Hopefully this strike will convince them to stop needlessly terrorizing local systems.
crimson-crusade:
Over the past few years, reports of a fast growing group of fanatics have been spreading, and resources are being stolen from local industrial and agricultural installations to fuel their efforts. The group calls themselves "The Crimson Inclination" and follow a charismatic leader that goes by the alias "High Lord Fransson." The regional Warlords had viewed the theft of industrial and agricultural materials by the group as nothing more than a minor nuisance. But then, three months ago, High Lord Fransson and his followers mobilized in force utilizing a significant number of previously unknown BattleMech forces to secure the capital city and surrounding territory of Najha, and have been publicly attempting to declare Najha an independent system no longer recognizing Draconis Combine rule.

This is a delusion the Dragon will never stand for. The DCMS has mobilized the Sixth Arkab Legion in an effort to crush the Crimson Inclination and liberate Najha from these fanatics. The Sixth Arkab Legion has requested mercenary support to clear a beachhead for them to land in force against the Crimson Inclination. Your contract with House Kurita, should you choose to accept, will be to secure a landing zone for the Arkab Legion, and support House Kurita in any manner they deem fit to destroy High Lord Fransson and his Crimson Inclination.

To the mercenary Commander, the Dragon thanks you for successfully claiming a landing site for the Sixth Arkab. Thanks to your efforts, the Legion was able to successfully push against the capital city and have freed Najha of The Crimson Inclination's delusions of grandeur. Sadly, that cockroach Fransson and a number of his supporters have escaped and have fled the system. Their surviving forces are too insignificant to dedicate an entire regiment to track down, but House Kurita wishes to see High Lord Fransson dead before he can amass more followers to his cause. We wish for your unit to take up the hunt and eliminate Fransson and his lackeys once and for all.

To assist you in this manner, we are transferring your contract to the Draconis Combine's Internal Security Force. An ISF liaison will provide your CO with all the info on what they believe is Fransson's safe house. You are to act on the ISF's information and eliminate any Crimson Inclination safe house you might find, and report directly back to the ISF on your findings. Together we will root out these fanatics and end their threat to the Combine for good.

The ISF thanks you for your diligence on flushing out this Crimson Inclination vermin. Our DEST cleanup teams have investigated the safe house you destroyed and have uncovered a number of documents at the scene. It will take time to piece together a full picture of the Crimson Inclination's greater network, but early examinations indicate that Fransson and a number of his top lieutenants were not present during your attack. We believe that he and his top staff were off world attempting to contact an unknown sponsor in an effort to resupply their forces. Naturally, we cannot allow for this to happen.

Although it will take time to unravel the Inclination's greater network, we believe we have located Lord Fransson himself in the Ardoz system. Our sources cite that he pilots a heavily modified Dragon BattleMech. We want you to travel to Ardoz and put an end to his ambitions once and for all.

Commander,

The ISF has confirmed that Lord Fransson is dead. We have you to thank for this. Unfortunately his 'Mech was never recovered. Supporters loyal to his cause took his 'Mech and fled the system. And we believe we know why.

Further examination of the documents recovered on Mannedorf have unveiled that High Lord Fransson had made contact with House Steiner LOKI agents and entered a deal with them. LOKI appears to be financially propping up the Crimson Inclination in order to wage a proxy war with the regional Warlords. We believe that without High Lord Fransson, Crimson Inclination's deal with LOKI falls apart. Our analyst believe that the Crimson Inclination's remaining leadership still intends to make contact with House Steiner's LOKI agents in an attempt to resupply their depleted forces, with one of their surviving members posing as Fransson himself. This operation has grown bigger than the Crimson Inclination. It is now of the utmost importance to not only crush the Crimson Inclination, but unveil and capture these LOKI agents.

To accomplish this we are coordinating with the DCMS for a joint operation. Commander, you will act as bait and draw the remaining Inclination forces into a narrow, muddy ravine where the Sixth Arkab Legion will be waiting for them. The deep mud in this region wreaks havoc on a 'Mech's gyros. So, if you force them into the designated ravine, they will be sitting ducks for the Legion to eliminate them. Stealth is of the utmost importance for this mission. We cannot allow for the LOKI agents to be tipped off prior to us eliminating the remaining Inclination forces. So we must insist that your collective force does not exceed 50 tons. Anything more will be impossible to mask your advance. Due to the mud in the area, it is also recommended that you bring a jump capable 'Mech into this operation.

Best of luck, Commander.
defend-the-enhanced: The residents of our beloved Free Worlds League are wonderfully tolerant and accepting of our racially and culturally diverse empire. However, this diversity leads to great divisions in opinion on a number of topics among various member-states. Bionic Enhancements being one of these divisive topics. Despite their medical necessity in many cases, some regions of the League tend to harbor bigoted views over those who rely on bionic prosthetics. A fanatical faction has arisen from this prejudice, claiming to uphold the ideal purity of the "natural, unmodified human form." The fanatics have taken the bigotry one step further by sending out a manifesto. They are planning to target clinics and manufacturing sites that provide bionic enhancements to those in need—including patients who require prosthetics to replace missing limbs or digits. Despite the obfuscation of our company name and the careful placement of our facilities, we have been discovered. Local law enforcement will not act without substantiated evidence, but by the time the fanatics strike, it will already be too late. We are soliciting your help to prevent this tragedy by stopping these fanatics before they can hit our facilities.

defending-the-honor:
Count Derick Cameron-Jones, leader of the Principality of Regulus in the Free Worlds League, is undertaking a goodwill tour of Regulan worlds with an honor guard drawn from the ranks of the Fourth Regulan Hussars, in which I currently serve. However, I anticipate trouble during this tour. The count's head of security has dismissed my concern as mere paranoia, so I am in search of mercenary forces in the area who can help protect the count from a potential uprising within the ranks.

The Fourth Regulan Hussars have historically been staffed by personnel from the Regulan world of Muscida, but myself and several members of the honor guard hail from Gibson, a former Regulan system that many Regulans distrust. Although we Gibsonians have proven ourselves as assets to the Fourth, many personnel question our integrity and insist on calling us foreigners and traitors to Regulus.

It is my firm belief that the dissidents within the Fourth are somehow orchestrating a false-flag attack on Count Cameron-Jones during his tour, where they pose as pirates and attack his entourage, solely to discredit my unit and claim that Gibsonians are unworthy of serving in the count's honor guard. I do not know when this attack against the count will commence, but my unit may not be large enough to fend it off, regardless of how loyal we remain to the count.

Myself and the other Gibsonians in the honor guard wish to contract you to supplement our detachment, as a precaution. I hope I am wrong about this, but when the safety of a provincial leader is at stake, we cannot afford to take risks.

You saved Count Cameron-Jones from the initial attacks, but the dissidents within the Fourth Regulan Hussars will not let up so easily, now that you have interfered in their so-called training exercise. They will undoubtedly strike again while the count is en route to his DropShip. If you wish to see justice done, then meet the dissidents head on, and form a wall between them and the count. Fight for as long as you can, to ensure he boards his DropShip safely.

Commander, your timely intervention in this cowardly attempt on my life has earned you my eternal gratitude. It pains me to see members of the Fourth Regulan Hussars taking up arms against me, but they have committed treason in their plotting against the loyal Gibsonians within their ranks, and their reckoning is at hand. Now, run down these traitors and destroy them before they can escape. You shall be awarded a bounty for killing their leader in my name.

destabilization:
—INCOMING MESSAGE—

Sender: UNKNOWN

We represent a wealthy group of concerned citizens unhappy with how Captain-General Janos Marik continues to ignore the problems our worlds are facing. We would like to send him a message. You will initiate strikes to destabilize the region between the Principality of Regulus and the Duchy of Oriente, ancient rivals for political power within the Free Worlds League. These combined hits will enable us to demand the Captain-General turn his attentions to the citizens that need aid.

The first of several strikes will target a manufacturing hub. A private security force is on the premises, but that should be no obstacle for a commander with your battlefield acumen.

—INCOMING MESSAGE—

Sender: UNKNOWN

We regret the decision to withhold the information that the private security force you faced was part of Earthwerks-FWL, Inc., but our efforts are all on a need-to-know basis. Yes, you've angered one of the largest transnational corporations within the Free Worlds League, but that is for a good cause. Our citizens must be protected, and the predations of Regulus and Oriente must be curtailed.

Your next objective will be to raze a food processing plant. There are plenty of food reserves in all affected sectors, so your actions will not create undue hardship. Remain confident that you are serving the greater good, for your success in this campaign will ultimately help many people whose voices would otherwise fall on deaf ears in Parliament.

—INCOMING MESSAGE—

Sender: UNKNOWN

The final raid will seal the deal as you destroy stockpiles of parts and munitions. It may seem counterintuitive to destroy such goods, but they are all manufactured by the sweat of our brows before being shipped off to war fronts hundreds of light years distant, while others make untold riches off of our honest labor. The ease with which your raids were carried out in the heartland of the League will force both the Captain-General and Parliament to sit up and take notice.
dire-circumstances:
Hello, mercenary.

Living out in the Taurian Concordat, we've learned to sleep with one eye open. The threat of a Davion invasion is always looming overhead, and we've spotted a potential shark in the waters. The planet of Cyrton was recently raided by what appeared to be a Davion scouting party coming from the Montour system. Protector Calderon sees this as a clear sign that Hanse Davion has already begun infiltrating our nation in an attempt to cordon the entire Concordat. The Protector wants to ready the entire nation for war and initiate a pre-emptive counter invasion. But high ranking officials in the Taurian Defense Force want to handle this incident in a more level headed way.

We would like to enlist your services to investigate this raiding party and destroy those responsible for the raid on Cyrton. Your first mission is to confirm that these raiders truly were affiliated with the Federated Suns. We want you to travel out to the Montour system and provoke the local defenders into attacking you. We will monitor their unit compositions and see if they have any marks that would affiliate them with the raiders that attacked Cyrton.

Provided that you help us track down those responsible for the Cyrton raids, we are prepared to offer you a Heavy 'Mech as payment for the group's utter destruction.

Good luck. We're counting on you.

This is an interesting development, mercenary.

We analyzed your battle computer, and sifted through the remains of the 'Mechs you downed. Something is strange in that the hostiles on Montour don't seem to fit the description of the Davion regiment. It now appears possible that the enemy force was not actually belonging to a Davion battle company, but a band of marauding pirates that disguised themselves as Federation forces.

The Taurian Ministry of Intelligence has tracked the group back to the world of Badlands, better known as Pirate's Haven. The Taurian Guard have been activated and will travel to Pirate's Haven to bring justice to those cowards who would dare provoke us. We want you to join the Taurian Guard, and assist them in neutralizing this mystery force. Whether they are Davion or pirate in origin, make sure none of them miss their date with the executioner.

So it's all become clear. 

We took some POWs from your last attack and subjected them to some... advanced interrogation techniques. The pirate forces were indeed making it appear like they were Davion forces preparing to stage an attack on us. It seems like they were attempting to coax us into war with Davion forces in an attempt to make Taurian worlds easier targets for plunder— something that almost happened, if we did not possess our trademark Taurian discipline.

The remaining forces have retreated to an area of Pirate's Haven known as "The Black Cliffs." A labyrinthine network of tall canyons that are impossible to scout or assault by air. We will need to descend into the labyrinth by 'Mech and clear them out all at once. Continue to assist the Taurian Guard and make sure no one escapes our Marshal's justice.
errant-signal:
One of our communications teams has picked up a weak coded signal coming from a planet that should, in theory, be uninhabited. Our analysts have been unable to decipher the message, but the signal itself is indicative of illegal habitation. The Celestial Wisdom would ask you to investigate this planet on behalf of the Confederation and deal with any interlopers you encounter. You are authorized to use lethal force if necessary.

Report back to us when the job is done, and you will be rewarded accordingly for your efforts.

We have deciphered part of the coded messages from that illegal settlement. It is now clear to us that we intercepted the internal communications of a House Davion strike team gearing up to wreak havoc on one of our industrial worlds. The Chancellor has shifted priority of your operation and is redirecting reinforcements to assist in dealing with these deceitful Davion dogs. Hold them off for as long as you are able. Every Fedrat you destroy will earn you a combat bonus for your continued service to the Confederation.
forceful-negotiations: The Tamarind Mining Company has surveyed a selection of star systems near the Duchy of Tamarind and found high quantities of radioactive minerals, which are lucrative for mining and will improve the well-being of these systems. We have authorization from Parliament to persuade the locals to cede the rights to their land, which sit atop the deposits. However, the land is populated with Star League–era ruins. Plus, the locals have embraced the worst tendencies of ComStar adepts and their pseudoreligious ways towards technology, and thus are fanatical about protecting their lands. A few raids against these lands to intimidate the residents should change their perspectives and remind them what it could be like without additional protections we can provide. You'll likely find no worthwhile technology after all these centuries, but prospecting for lostech is an excuse that should justify your presence in the ruins. All that we ask is to keep civilian casualties to a minimum. We are not in the business of killing for profit.

The residents aren't nearly as cowed as we hoped. See the forwarded messages for their response:

"You shall not intimidate us. The blood of the ancients that once graced this land flows in our veins. We are not blessed to understand the technologies that inhabit the darkest recesses, but just as their light once flowed, it may yet flow again. Tamper with it at your own peril. You have been warned."

It would seem it's time to up the ante, Commander. This time you must go in and destroy a portion of the ruins these people hold dear. Perhaps that will teach them the lesson we wish them to learn.

The locals are...exceptionally upset. Your efforts have not frightened them into abandoning their land. Instead, you have filled them with righteous fury. The few locals who understand what we are attempting to accomplish have informed us that the mercenaries they hired to defend the ruins are now coming directly for you. We offer our sincerest hopes that you can endure their assault.

hazing-of-the-weak:
Greetings Commander…I am the Will Of Kali, liaison and loyal servant to the Church Of Kali. You haven’t heard of us? That is by design. Our Church and it’s goals are only to be known to our most loyal members…for now. Unfortunately however we have a problem that has to be dealt with quickly and quietly. We made the difficult decision to contact a mercenary and with your outstanding reputation to deal with delicate matters we hope we can trust this to you.
 
One of our disciples seems to have…jumped the gun on our plans. She has left the flock and decided to begin sacrificing settlers in the Sendalor system. We cannot provide her name as we do not know it. All disciples must leave their past life at the door, and that includes their name; the only identity that matters is that of the true ruler. We will not tolerate this heresy, Commander. Her insubordination to our true ruler must be dealt with, and we are fully confident that you know how to end this. Travel to this settlement and make her feel our wrath.

Damn this pathetic blasphemer! She may have escaped your grasp, but lucky for you our arms stretch across the galaxy and have located her base of operations. It appears that she controls a settlement in the Housekarle system. You must go there and raze it to the ground while ensuring that no one escapes. The Eyes Of Kali watch you closely now, Commander. Do not fail us again; cleanse the system of this insurgent and her weak followers. Another failure and you will make an enemy you will fear until your final days.

We intercepted some of the blasphemer's followers as they fled your last attack. After some... persuasion, they were kind enough to provide us with some information.

So the heretic goes by the name Aditi Whidbey…before you even made it back to your ship, the loyal followers of the true leader were able to get everything we need on this disobedient scum. It seems she believes herself to be still in service of the true leader! The Mind Of Kali found much on her new ideology. It seems she was desperate to find new followers to “our” cause and was spouting a false interpretation of our beliefs to anyone misguided enough to listen. Somehow this pretender became mad, she thinks the true leader spoke to her privately and told her to single-handedly speed up the process of achieving some of our goals while also bringing in new followers all on her own. This filth…it gets even more preposterous from there, in her ravings she mentions repeatedly a fear of a human-like dog she calls “The Big Dog” and she has an irrational fear of being covered in dog food.

Clearly Whidbey never spoke with our true leader privately, but her insane ramblings and actions continue to be the biggest threat of destroying the Church Of Kali along with everything we worked so long to achieve. Luckily for your well-being The Arms Of Kali once again tracked her down for you. She didn’t travel far this time and has been located in the nearby system of Grand Base. Kill this madwoman, Commander, before we decide to take out our frustration and kill you instead.

I’ll keep this brief. You are quite lucky you followed Aditi Whidbey’s escape out of that system so closely. Another failure and The Hand Of Kali would be forced to immediately fire upon your ship. But, since you have the heretic in your sights, The Hand showed compassion. You and your crew have one final chance to meet our request. Whidbey is headed towards the Claxton System. One way or another, one of you won’t leave that system alive.
heir-of-nothing:
Greetings Commander,

I am Duke Elias Von Richter.

As a man with a keen focus on my legacy, I've started to look into the future, towards a time when I'm no longer here. I do not have any direct heirs and so, normally upon my passing, my younger brother Emil would be set to gain everything, including my royal title of duke. But Emil is vain, spoiled, narcissistic, and ill-suited to rule an entire planet. I do not want my legacy as the Duke of Penobscot tarnished by the succession of someone so unworthy to rule.

So I have taken steps to ensure that Emil will never inherit anything from my estate: not my wealth, not my royal titles, nor my land-grants. Upon my death, my titles and all my possessions are to be returned to the Commonwealth and donated to the people of Penobscot. But despite previously inheriting a fortune that makes him wealthy enough to live in the lap of luxury for the rest of his life, Emil feels slighted at the notion of being denied my possessions. He seeks the dukedom and the prestige it comes with, feeling that he is owed what he has never once sacrificed to earn.

Rumors swirling around my royal court have whispered that Emil is building up a large mercenary force with ambitions to usurp me of my titles. And while they are nothing but court rumors at the moment, it has caused enough concern from my Honor Guard that they begged me to bring in an independent party to investigate.

I don't have any proof of wrong doing, so I will need a mercenary with discretion. I want you to take out some of the lieutenants of this supposed mercenary force Emil is assembling, and report back to me with your findings.

These are no mere mercenaries! Emil is assembling loyal servants of the Free Worlds League!

That traitor! I would never have imagined that Emil would sink to getting into bed with the League to take what is mine! The Archon will see him hang for this!

Even worse, the League forces now know that they've been made. Their troops have now mobilized and are closing in on my estate! I need you to join my Honor Guard to intercept and repel my brother's troops. They are attempting to ford the Verona River at the edge of my land. My life and all of the Commonwealth is depending on this! Do not let us down mercenary.

Commander, it's time for us to go on the offensive.

Emil and his forces have retreated and are hiding out in his mountain villa. League forces are heavily fortifying the mountain road leading to his property. A small mountain road is the only path leading up to Emil's villa. So this is where the League forces will be preparing for a fight.

We must continue to take the fight to him. If we clear the mountain pass, Emil will be trapped and have no place left to retreat to.
ideals-of-war:
Commander Mason,

Welcome to wave one of Operation Guerrero. We're happy to have your outfit onboard. League Commandos infiltrated Van Diemen IV in advance of the invasion and muzzled much of the world’s command and communications networks. Our ’Mechs were already raining down onto the ground before the Third Republican defenders even knew what was happening. Hell of a way to be apprised of the situation.

Clearly, the unscheduled visit sent them scrambling to find panic buttons to hit. It didn’t take long before that panic became loud enough to be heard. The Marik assault force is in the atmosphere ready to land as we speak. They picked up warning transmissions from The Republican commanders. Clearly a piece of their communication line is still intact.

I’m sending your group in to sever the remaining piece of their communication line in this region. We've been able to turn over a couple stones and find some targets that were masked during the initial attack. With any luck, knocking down those targets will cut their coordination efforts on the ground long enough to faciliate a safe landing for the Tenth and Twenty Third Marik Militia forces. We need them to strengthen our fist of attack so we can pummel the Third Republican forces into submission and secure this world.

Go earn your pay, Commander.

Commander,

Well, my recon teams were able to come through and confirm what I already suspected: they’ve got a fully operational radar scrambling network screwing with our instruments. No doubt the Third Republican forces are sitting back, waiting for us to wander out and offer ourselves up for easy target practice. I've also been informed that units from the Twenty-Third Marik Militia have been charged with guarding our drop zone. We don't want the Republican forces sneaking up on them and taking free shots.

We need those jammers disabled for the health and safety of this entire operation. I’m designating you as an assault lance to solve this problem. Storm into the target area like lightning and disable that network. I want to send a message to the Republican high command that the Captain-General did not send us here to play games. I'll be damned if we're listed as a reason one of the Captain-General's targeted worlds is not captured during Operation Guerrero. I refuse to allow that to be stamped onto my service record. 

I’ll be monitoring your movements, Commander. Get ready to deploy.

Commander,

We’re slowly chipping away at the Third Republican forces. Elements from my Hussars and the Tenth Marik Militia continue to work to box them in. But our latest movement reports show a large group of Republicans trying to reach their DropShips via an escape route.

I scouted this area before planetfall and identified it as a place they might try to divert their forces if things went sideways for them.

I need you to join up with the force I have stationed along that route and help them cut off the escape of those Republican forces.  Hold your ground and do not give them an easy ticket out of here.

Commander, 

When I told you more Republican forces were headed right for you, I wasn’t joking. There’s a ton of enemy signatures headed for your line like meteors. It’s clear their desperation levels are starting to ratchet up. I’ve spoken to the Tenth. They’ve intercepted a massive pocket of forces and have pinned them down, but they can’t take their knees off their necks to help you.

You all have to screw your resolve to the post and do not allow the Republican forces to run through you.

Dig in and hold strong.

Commander,

My remaining Hussars are ready to leave. Operation Guerrero is over for them. This is the last request I thought I'd be making before we hit the ground. I didn't believe that Van Diemen would be a cakewalk, but I didn't think my KIA would be this high. They took a massive bite out of my forces. I know the last thing my remaining warriors want is to leave when there is still work to be done, I need to rotate them off planet and give them some time to heal up, or I won't have any MechWarriors left to command. 

You've already fought like hell, more than pulled your weight out here, but I need to ask more of you. The Republican forces are sniffing around. I’ve ID’d some priority targets for you to knock out so we can leave without further incident. Please head in and tie them up, Commander. I've got enough funerals to attend, I don't want to add more to the list.

Commander,

I’ve just been informed that the remaining Third Republican Forces are making a break for it again. They have DropShips spooling up to escape. But the stand that cost me many good warriors bought the Marik Commandos time to sabotage them. So they aren’t going anywhere! No doubt they are desperate and have nothing to lose, so expect a hell of a struggle to finally put them down.

The Marik Militia will provide you with your target sectors so you can wrap this up.  

Good luck, Commander. I look forward to the after-action report. I want to inform my surviving MechWarriors that the Republican forces have been removed from Van Diemen for good, or they’ve finally tapped out. That will be the only thing that will boost their morale.

They've all told me to implore you to give them hell. They wish they could be down there with you. I echo those sentiments, Commander... Hit them with a little something extra... For my fallen.
industrial-espionage:
This message comes with warm regards from Rashpur-Owens, Incorporated. Here at Rashpur-Owens, our production of JumpShips and DropShips is a shining beacon of pride and resilience for all Capellans.

Despite our trailblazing innovation to keep our ancient factory online, we run on razor-thin margins, and our facilities continue to slide into disrepair. The New Syrtis Shipyards, firmly entrenched with our hated enemy, House Davion, allow their DropShips to be illegally sold at bargain-basement prices, which undercuts our profits, thus furthering that slide.

Although Skye has always maintained a pilot light of secessionist thought throughout the centuries, the loss of our worlds to the Draconis Combine and Free Worlds League during the Third Succession War has fanned this flame into an active rebellion against the Archon. Civil discourse has fallen by the wayside, and our region is a lit match away from detonating the proverbial powder keg and turning the Isle's dissension into armed revolt. The Archon tasked Aldo Lestrade IV and Ryan Steiner, with defusing the situation, but they both support the Free Skye movement and thus will do nothing to hinder our cause.

We, who seek for the Isle of Skye to secede from the Lyran Commonwealth, ask for your services to supplement the Skye Rangers who support an independent Isle of Skye.

new-home-old-enemies:
Commander,

I represent a group seeking help to calm the waters on New Home, a world embroiled in the Chaos March. When Katherine Steiner-Davion declared her Lyran districts in a state of crisis, the Federated Commonwealth fractured into two halves. This family drama and personal squabbles between the great houses of the Inner Sphere have left many worlds directionless, with their people forced to fend for themselves amid growing anarchy.

My people have sacrificed too much to allow the innocents and lands we fought for to fall into ruin. Pirate groups are raiding New Home, knocking over food silos and supply convoys, smuggling black market goods, and terrorizing citizens through kidnappings and ransom demands. These actions are driving inflation, shortages, and desperation, forcing civilians to comply just to survive. While we move to protect the people, we have also uncovered Lyran Alliance operations in the region. New Home is rich in natural resources, and it appears the Lyrans are conducting mineral extraction while doing nothing to curb the pirate threat.

We are assembling a force of mercenaries to return New Home to its people. This is more than a contract, it is a chance to restore hope where the Great Houses have failed. Your first operation will see you attached to one of our divisions to root out a particularly heinous pirate group responsible for the kidnappings and ransom demands mentioned earlier. While no pirate is welcome on this world, this faction stands above the rest as a priority target. 

Consider joining us in this cause and help bring light back to those left behind.

Commander,

These unbranded pirates know no shame. They have targeted a mineral excavation site, one of the few the Lyran’s haven’t been using for their gains, and have taken a few hostages. They insist on being spared the noose so they can flee. You remember what I told you before? They look for any reason to execute their captives, so as long as those civilians are their prisoners, their long-term health is at risk. 

They’ve got a force guarding the area awaiting word. I am assigning you to head to that site and negotiate with your auto-cannons. Send the message loud and clear: New Home will no longer be a haven for this despicable pirate scum!

Do not stop blasting those pirates until the message sinks in, or there is nothing left to even suggest they were here in the first place.

Commander,

I already told you the Lyran’s have been busy pilfering New Home of its natural resources. The citizens have suffered significant consequences as a result. Their export revenue streams have plummeted. The Lyran’s have taken control of their infrastructure arms and slowed down everything across the planet. The environmental impact has always been severe, with farmlands scarred and forests affected.

It is clear that the Lyran’s care nothing for the long-term spiral that this activity is inducing. We wish to begin removing the Lyran’s from this particular region to stop this revenue loss, and infrastructure decay, and give the citizens of this region back their identity and way of life.

I’m assigning you and another division to engage the Lyran Guards that are in the system guarding the mining operation. So far, they have been met with no resistance, but they are about to get plenty. Once the Lyran Guards are removed from this area, we can plant our flag here, and the workers who have been displaced can reclaim it.

See it done, Commander. The Lyran’s presence on this planet is about to be contested.
no-pilot-left-behind:
MechWarrior, my name is Pavel Shenzeng, and I send this message in hopes you will bend an ear to my plight.

The Shenzengs are a noble family, known not only for devotion to the Capellan Confederation but also our proud service on the battlefield. My days piloting a BattleMech are long behind me, but my son, Dimitri, has carried on our fine legacy.

Unfortunately, he was downed in battle a month ago and captured by a band of pirates. They’re holding him and several others in captivity and are demanding a ransom. Although it is against our nature to bow to such a request, I am willing to hire the services of a mercenary command to help retrieve him and any other good Capellan citizens they have imprisoned.

I’m unsure of his actual location, but I’ve tracked the initial message to a suspected pirate hideout in the Lopez system. The inhabitants have established this base among the wilds of the local branth  population, as they believe these dangerous "living dragons" will give them extra protection.

Please, help an old warrior save his son's life.

It seems the pirates are craftier than we thought. The pilot and the other prisoners were either moved before we struck or they were never at the base to begin with. The attack, however, was not fruitless, as we've followed the pirates' tracks to what is likely the captives' true location. To keep from spooking the pirates before we're ready to strike, I'll need you to do some tricky maneuvering. If your 'Mechs can draw the pirates away from their main operating base, your dropship should be able to head down planetside and extract the prisoners while they're occupied.
noble-cause:
Hurting the syndicate where it counts most--in their pocketbook--might just give these miners the leverage they need to get better working conditions, and possibly something approaching fair pay.

The mission is a simple ground and pound. Locate the two facilities and do as much damage as possible. Do that and we’ll help send them a message they hopefully can’t ignore.
operation-onoda:
It's been a long struggle for the Free Rasalhague Republic to remain an independent state, especially when our former oppressors still eye the territory we fought for generations to liberate. We thought that our national nightmare of continued oppression under Kuritan warlords ended a year ago when we emerged victorious from the Ronin Wars. However, some ronin from the Combine, under the banner of Satoshi Takeda, are still hungry for blood.

Despite Kanrei Theodore Kurita's expedition force of loyal Combine troops that assisted the Republic in eliminating a majority of the disgraced ronin, not all of them were killed or captured.  They survived, fueling resentment towards both the people of the Free Rasalhague Republic and Kanrei Kurita.

For the past year, Satoshi Takeda, formally a member of the Fifth Amphigean Light Assault Group, has rallied surviving ronin to his banner to continue his crusade of once again subjugating the Rasalhague people in the name of Coordinator Takashi Kurita. Recently, the group was able to take control of the entire system of Dehgolan. Which they now have claimed to be the lawful subjects of Takashi Kurita.

The Coordinator has remained silent on the matter, while Kanrei Theodore Kurita publicly denounced the actions of the group. But he refuses to once again send troops into Republic space to deal with the ronin. While our diplomats with the Combine are hoping that we can find a peaceful solution to this matter.

But the Republic cannot stand by while our citizens are once again subjugated under the boots of Combine denizens. We need assistance in dealing with Takeda and his forces. While the Republic loathes to seek the assistance of mercenaries after many of them abandoned us during the Ronin Wars, we are still not in a state in which we can take out Takeda on our own. We will need you to link up with the First Tyr Regiment and assist them in ending the ambitions of Satoshi Takeda.

The first operation will involve setting up a base of operations in the territory that has fallen under Takeda's control and clear a way for the First Tyr to land on Dehgolan unharmed. We ask you to join our forces in defending our position and clean out any ronin units for good.

Now that we've established our foothold on the planet, we can engage in primary contact with the bulk of the ronin forces. Takeda has mobilized to meet us in a swampy region of the planet known regionally as The Stinking Pools, so be prepared for an absolute brawl in a fairly open terrain that is often coated in notoriously heavy fog. However, this isn't anything you can't handle. If we come out on top, we will be able to force Takeda's ronin further back into the planet, where we can surgically dismantle the rest of the unit. Gear up and get ready to go forth into battle!

Great work so far, Commander.

After our victory in open battle, Takeda is dead by your hand. However it seems that his death wasn't quite enough to dissuade the remaining ronin who continue to swear vengeance against the citizens of Dehgolan. We will not allow them to take their frustrations out on the innocent civilians of Dehgolan; the First Tyr will be moving to secure our civilian centers and act as a garrison against any ronin aggression. You will be tasked with finding and eliminating the remaining ronin lieutenants. Cutting off the remaining heads of this snake should finally put an end to this national nightmare once and for all.
picking-at-the-scraps:
Nearby systems have been caught in the wake of the Black Inferno’s march, so they’re vulnerable and exposed. Most of these worlds are simple farming and extraction planets, but they still offer valuable resources that my clients are looking to acquire at, shall we say, "reasonable prices." If you’re willing to look past any moral quandaries, we'd like you to help us grab the supplies we need by staging a diversionary raid. If you drop into the affected planet and grab the attention of whatever defenses are still viable, then we will send in salvage crews while you're engaging the locals. Anything of value our teams find beyond what we need will be your payment for this contract.

If it helps orient your moral compass, don't think of the job as aiding and abetting thievery. Think of the job as "accelerated negotiations": Our clients need these supplies far more than the local people do. Without them, they'll survive, but our clients won't.
