picking-up-the-pieces: This is an open call to any and all mercenary commands in the region. Our humble farming complex has suffered greatly at the hands of the Black Inferno. They came through, took out our meager defenses, and put many of our fields to the torch, and pirate raiders calling themselves Vogel's Vandals have plagued us ever since. We are clinging to what precious little we have left here, but we’ve pooled our funds and are offering honest pay to any command willing to protect our home from these raiders. Drive them away from our planet so that we can live in peace.

You really stuck it to those Vandals, and we can’t thank you enough…but you kicked the hornets' nest a bit too hard. When they come back for revenge, they'll take it out on us. Fortunately, one of our own managed to pick up radio chatter about their home base, which is in a nearby system. If you go there and take out the leader, Victor Vogel, his Vandals may scatter and finally leave this part of the Inner Sphere for good. Please, this may be our only chance.
pirate-hunt:
Many residents in the Rasalhague Military District pay only lip service to House Kurita, and the loyal service of the DCMS regiments drawn from their population remains likewise questionable. While the troops in this region follow orders, there are rogue elements within the district, and some have allowed their disloyal natures to corrupt their better selves.

Tai-sa Luukas Ranta, formerly of the First Altenmarkt Militia, is one such fallen soul. When even his general could not curtail his outspoken, anti-Kurita attitudes, the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery was forced to step in. Instead of accepting his punishment, he led a portion of his loyal soldiers into the outer reaches of the Combine, embracing a life of piracy. Such a show of disloyalty by a high-ranking Combine warrior—and hailing from a unit intended to curtail rebellious activity—is not only embarrassing to the DCMS, but if the traitor is not put down with prejudice, this situation could shatter the already weakening faith the people in this region have in the Coordinator.

These deserters must be hunted down—not only to stop their activities, but to dissuade other Rasalhagians from a similar path. Be aware that Ranta himself might be difficult to confront at first; however, if you strip the protection his subcommanders provide, he will have little choice but to face you on the battlefield himself.

Your first target involves the liberation of a farming community Ranta's pirates have occupied. Their utter lack of honor may force them to use the locals as human shields, or they might raze farmland to distract you from your objectives. Destroy any bandits you find in the area, but keep casualties among the peasantry to a minimum, and preserve as much agricultural property as possible. Even peasants serve an important function for the Dragon.

You are to be commended for your restraint when the cowardly pirates attempted to use peasants as shields. However, you allowed many of the traitors to escape justice. To rectify this oversight and remain in the good graces of the Professional Soldiery Liaison, you must complete the job.

Ranta's band of traitors have gone to ground on a world renowned for its storms. You'll need to follow them and fight through the terrifying weather. Ranta's second-in-command is known believed to be in the area. Eliminate him and any of the deserters under his command, and the path to Ranta himself should be clear.

We have finally located Ranta's bolthole: a hidden base on one of the system's many moons. Our reconnaissance flights show that he has a heavy amount of muscle guarding him, but we're confident you're up to the task of taking him down once and for all. If you can corner him, beware, for he will fight like a demon to avoid death or capture.
pirate-raiders: Intel recovered from Winfield leads us to believe that Kalamar intends to attack the outpost located on the planet of Toland.  We've jumped into the system ahead of the pirates, in hopes of laying an ambush.  To the best of our knowledge we should have the element of surprise.  The mission will be simple - lay in wait at the garrison on Hill Point until Kalamar and his forces land.  We're going to be alone on this one.  Our support JumpShip will be leaving for the Apollo system.  We don't know how many units Kalamar plans to commit to this attack, so be ready for anything.  The most likely drop point will be south of the garrison on a small plateau.  There will be local militia support, but don't count on them to be anything but a pain in your ass.  The small community of North Bend lays just north of the garrison.  Civilian casualties will result in the forfeit of all bonuses.

Alright, listen up!  We've chased this bastard to the end of the universe.  It's time to end this now.  Jake Kalmar and his band of pirates have retreated back to Sigurd.  This frozen moon is deep in the Oberon Confederation's territory. We anticipate resistance to be significant. The Star Fort heavily defended by a well armed garrison. Advanced intel is sketchy on total numbers, but we anticipate at least one full company of BattleMechs, supporting tanks and air units. How many are active, and the readiness of these units is also unknown. Be ready for several heavy engagements. We expect you’ll face a usual mix of BattleMechs seen in previous encounters with this pirate group. As you can see there are several approaches to the Star Fort. There is a single ramp to the plateau and main garrison on the northwest side. You’ll have to asses the best route once on the ground. Based on our limited intel, we recommend approaching from the east side.
project-cold-snap:
Our ISF intelligence has surfaced rumors that Steiner forces are planning an attack on a remote research complex belonging to the Cosby BattleMech and Myomer Research Firm in the Kajikazawa star system. It is home to a project known as "Project Cold Snap," an experimental endeavor to develop 'Mech myomer that is designed to withstand extreme weather conditions. 

It seems that House Steiner is not too happy with the thought of the Dragon gaining enhanced technology that would better our already superior BattleMech forces. So we are tasking you with assisting the ISF BattleMech defenders with clearing out hostile forces should House Steiner be foolish enough to attack our facility. But be warned, while the extreme weather of the planet is beneficial for our testing purposes, it will make combat a dangerous undertaking.

Good. Now that the base's safety has been secured, it is time for the Dragon to strike back. 

We've discovered that the Steiner agents were attempting to steal the industrial secrets of Project Cold Snap for themselves, and we feel that the most appropriate form of retribution is to strike back. We have our eyes on a remote, yet extremely valuable, Defiance Industries research plant that produces Defiance branded 'Mech armor composites. We want you to destroy the plant with terror and ferocity that the Steiner mongrels could only dream of.
return-of-the-rangers:
Hello commander, my name is Nicholas Haas, representing the Premana Pacers. Have you ever seen a baseball game, Commander?

It’s ever so exciting! A player throws a ball to a second player, and a third player stands between them with a bat – a stick – and they try to hit the ball between two white lines…  Well, the rules aren’t important.  What’s important is that here in Premana, baseball is a popular and lucrative past-time, if you happen to own the winning teams.  That is why we're distressed to learn that the Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces have reinstated the Twentieth Skye Rangers and stationed them here in Premana.  If you haven’t heard of baseball, then you certainly haven’t heard of the Rangers, a regimental baseball team that won the planetary championship back in 2765, despite the best efforts of the franchise owners.  If the Rangers team resurfaces, they might severely cut into our profits. That is why you must stop the Skye Rangers from getting a foothold in this system.

We're requesting you destroy the storage facilities that are a direct part of the Rangers' supply chain.

This is not really about baseball, Commander, this is about business.

Unfortunately, it seems like your sabotage hasn't quite done enough. It looks like we'll have to resort to more... extreme measures. The original Rangers were formed after a Lyran general was posted out here on this system. Bored by the isolation, he and some of his men organized the team and went on to compete against other local teams like our own. The players however, are all ranking Lyran soldiers, and their duties must always come first. We would like you to cause a crises large enough to force their hand. With the team unable to compete, the Pacers will surely have a winning season!

What else can we do? We've tried destroying the Rangers' supply chain. We've tried causing a catastrophic attack to divert their manpower. But no matter what we throw you at, our opponents seem to persist. What is it going to take for them to pack up and get out of here? We're at the end of our ropes, and the amount we're paying you to remove the Rangers is almost enough to bribe the entire league. We've got one final plan. We will send out a fraudulent invasion warning in a planet nearest to the Rangers' garrison. If you hold your own for long enough, eventually the military forces who play for the Rangers will engage you in combat.

I know you must think that this is all very silly, but this league is serious business...

And it's an even more serious source of revenue.
rise-of-the-black-dragon:
FIELD COMMUNICATION: OMEGA SECURITY: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

Have you heard of the Kokuryu-Kai, the Black Dragon Society? They are a hardline traditionalist group that first formed in the 25th century who attempt to ardently enforce Urizen Kurita's Kokugaku. A National Learning program that stresses the culture and traditions of Japanese heritage above all others, despite the fact that a majority of the Draconis Combine's citizens hail from non-Japanese ancestry.  Many insist they died out long ago, but we have reason to believe not only are they still active but they are planning something that threatens national security. Our fear is that a member of the Kuritan Royal Family is in danger. While we have our own defenses, we need to utilize all the resources available. We are offering you a lucrative contract to pose as decoys while we will feed false information to the Black Dragon Society to draw them out of hiding.

The local duke has shown to be sympathetic towards his citizens of Rasalhague decent, which has drawn the ire of the Kokuryu-Kai. You will masquerade as the duke's personal guard as he conducts a tour of the worlds under his authority. We are confident the Black Dragons will rise up and make an attempt on the duke's life during this tour.

FIELD COMMUNICATION: OMEGA SECURITY: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

We did not expect such a strident response from the Kokuryu-Kai. We knew their support had grown in recent years, but even we do not understand the strength of that response. After such a brazen show of force, it is paramount that we engage the Black Dragons and reduce that strength as much as humanly possible. We must show them the error of their ways.

Since your subterfuge has been revealed, we suggest you retreat to the badlands, where the Black Dragon forces will seek to destroy you. The more Black Dragons you can dispatch, the weaker this threat to House Kurita will be.

FIELD COMMUNICATION: OMEGA SECURITY: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

With the help of your actions, the ISF has discovered the location of a significant Kokuryu-Kai leader. While our forces are still guarding the heir to the Dragon, you will attempt a sneak attack to eliminate the leader. Doing so will not entirely destroy the Kokuryu-Kai—its insidious infection will take far more purging—but cutting off one of the Black Dragons' many heads here will dampen their enthusiasm for some time.
shadow-war-dragon-s-breath:
FIELD COMMUNICATION: OMEGA SECURITY: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

The Coordinator rules the Draconis Combine through the careful orchestration of the power of his five Warlords. Allowing the Warlords to stave off each others' excesses keeps them both occupied and balanced, allowing the Dragon to rule. Yet there are times when the Dragon's Breath, the Internal Security Force, must extend our hand and upset that balance. And in that imbalance, the malaise of complacency sloughs away as dead skin, and a new, stronger Dragon emerges. Our sisters in the Order of the Five Pillars, though we respect their desire to safeguard the realm, are too often tied to the staid forms laid out in the Dictum Honorium and cannot see our vision of growth. Conflicts arise, as they are now.

Chairman Nakamura of the Dieron Military District—scion of an honored house dating back to the Star League—has rapidly expanded his influence in recent years. This has brought about an economic boom, spreading throughout the region. General Vasily Cherenkov, Warlord of the Dieron Military District, has greatly benefited, as his prestige and power have risen commensurately. Yet he has not allowed that prosperity to spread beyond those borders. General Hirushi Shotuguma, Warlord of the Benjamin Military District, knows that such unbalanced growth cannot be sustained. However, to remain in the past is folly. By working with Warlord Shotuguma, we are the stick to beat the sides of the Dragon toward greater growth. Our forces, masquerading as House Davion regiments, will strike at Chairman Nakamura. We would prefer to not kill such a capable son of the Dragon, but we will not hesitate. The Dragon must survive.

You will supplement our forces in the strike to crush Chairman Nakamura.

FIELD COMMUNICATION: OMEGA SECURITY: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

The Order of the Five Pillars surprised us by assaulting our base and postponing our attack on Chairman Nakamura, but they will not hinder us a second time.

Since we must assume that the O5P now possesses intel on our operation, we will proceed as planned but will shift our initial LZ from nav point Chi to nav point Tsu. This change of plan should confuse the O5P long enough to let us successfully prosecute our assault.

FIELD COMMUNICATION: OMEGA SECURITY: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

Your exemplary service to the Dragon has likely caught the direct attention of our sister organization, the Order of the Five Pillars. While the Abbess and her operatives serve the Dragon in their own way and are useful to the realm, their methods often directly interfere with the ISF's goals, as you have experienced thus far. If you receive a message from the Abbess, we advise you to ignore it and remain in our employ to counteract the Order's meddling.

As of now, the O5P's forces have fallen back, but they have set up a defensive position and insist on blocking our path to the objective. However, we have the initiative and the numbers. Press the attack and remove Chairman Nakamura from office—permanently. It is time to break the O5P and put an end to this shadow war.
shadow-war-order-of-the-five-pillars:
INCOMING MESSAGE: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

Greetings, Commander. Your service to the Dragon has been exemplary, despite following our ISF brothers' misguided plans. The ISF believes they are causing growth, but there is an important distinction between healthy growth and unchecked, cancerous growth. We of the Order of the Five Pillars believe you will see the error of the ISF's ways and join us in bringing stability to the realm.

Warlord Shotuguma has allowed his jealousy of Chairman Nakamura and Warlord Cherenkov's good fortune to overcome his senses, and he has been seduced by the ISF, giving them freer rein to operate in the Dieron Military District. You already participated in the plan to attack Chairman Nakamura while posing as Federated Suns forces. The ISF's subterfuge is too well crafted, however, and if the raids continue, Warlord Cherenkov will eye House Davion for his own punitive strikes. This could spiral into another great war along our border, which cannot be allowed to happen at this time.

If you join the O5P's effort to protect Chairman Nakamura, you will be well rewarded for your service to the Dragon. However, continue to follow the ISF's misguided crusade against Nakamura, and the O5P will ensure that you never find reputable mercenary work within this realm ever again.
shipping-disruption: At the end of the 29th century, the Gienah-DuraPaq land trains premiered as a joint venture between our two transnational corporations, and they have been moving vast quantities of materials across inhospitable worlds ever since—places where the infrastructure for more permanent shipping, such as rails, does not make economic sense. However, that agreement has profited DuraPaq far more than my company. And while all of my predecessors were too timid, I am not. It's time to tip those scales in our favor. A targeted strike at the shipping facilities on a border world will hit DuraPaq's bottom line without damaging our own assets. We'll then suggest better security contracts for protection, which we'll link to their profits, not ours. In a few years' time, the disparity will initiate several clauses in that original contract, allowing us to gain a greater control of the initiative. Everybody wins. Well, everyone except DuraPaq.

stop-the-launch:
Hello mercenary.

Retired General Lionel Stanz used to be a respected member of the Steiner High Command, despite his rather... fiery temperament. Lately, however, he has been expressing his vehement opposition to House Steiner's alliance with House Davion, and the signing of the FedCom Accords.

Stanz is now leading a local militia hellbent on sowing seeds of discord and war in this system, all under the rallying cry of independence for the people of Skye. Our intel suggests that he is in the possession of a rare nuclear device known as a "Peacemaker". To further complicate things, we suspect he still has supporters inside Lyran command, and may be aware of our every move. That's why we need you to intervene.

We previously thought that the installation you disabled was used for triangulating targets for the Peacemaker. Unfortunately it was a simple backup relay, which means that the other substations in this system are just as capable of firing the weapon of mass destruction. We've unearthed the location of another one of these stations. While you take it out, we will continue our search for the final relay station.

Mercenary, we've crippled Stanz's ability to launch the peacemaker, but he may still be planning to use the device manually. Our forces are scouring the area for the peacemaker, but of equal importance is to secure the device's detonator. Our intel has it on good authority that Stanz passed the detonator to someone within his inner circle for safe keeping. SAFE has provided us intel on potential safe houses. Your orders are to investigate each one until you find his inner circle and destroy them.

It's time to end Stanz's reign of terror. Loki agents have tracked Stanz's JumpShip to the Summer system. Our records show that his family owns land there, in a remote area.

Due to the severity of the threat, we're throwing as many of our troops at him as we can, including the Fifth Lyran Guards, but we need all available arms. Drop into the battle, join the assault, and take out Stanz. But be careful— Stanz is an experienced pilot and we've received reports that he's in control of a one-of-a-kind Battlemech.
testing-ground:
My name is Masako Suzuki from the DCMS procurement department. We are seeking a specialized mercenary unit to assist in testing a new ‘Mech prototype, developed by Luthien Armor Works using captured Loki and Thor technology. With the Truce of Tukayyid giving us time to prepare, this first wave of Sunder prototypes is ready for combat trials. 

Phase one will have you engage DCMS pilots in live-fire evaluations under Tai Shu Teyasu Ashora, Warlord of the Pesht Military District. You will push these machines to their limits to test their performance and expose flaws. 

Phase two will take you behind Smoke Jaguar lines for a live combat trial in a lightly defended system, alongside a unit of the Pesht Regulars. The goal is to assess performance in an uncontrolled environment while ensuring that none of these machines fall into enemy hands. If the Smoke Jaguars capture one, the program will be compromised. We believe your combat record against the Clanners makes your outfit an ideal choice for this assignment. 

We intend to begin immediately and await your response.

Commander,

The time has come. We are going to unveil our Sunders against the Smoke Jaguars. This has been a long time coming. This is not a simulated field test. The Smoke Jaguars will not hold anything back. As you know, there is a lot at stake. The success of this operation is a litmus test to see how far we’ve come in this war against the Clans. I don’t have to tell you that failure would be a massive step back in this effort to even the odds. We have identified a series of targets that will keep the Smoke Jaguars on the backfoot as we engage them and see how our machines fare against them.

I’d like you to hit the designated targets and make sure the Smoke Jaguars can't scramble a quick-response force or sneak up on us. Remember, it is imperative that none of our machines are extracted from the battlefield.

Commander,

We believe we’ve tested these Sunders enough. We don’t want to tempt fate and let our progress be undone. I have Regulars on the field engaged with a fierce set of Smoke Jaguars. I told you, now that they have ID’d what they are fighting, they’re clearly mandated to try and secure one to see what we’ve been up to.  So we need to pull all of our Sunders off the field and head back before we make a costly error.

I’m tapping you to go in and beat the Smoke Jaguars back long enough to get every last Sunder out of harm's way.  There’s no time to waste. Every minute that passes, we risk losing any type of edge we’ve gained against the Clans. And I have no interest in having my name attached to failure like that.

I’m going to start pulling units off the field once it’s safe. I’ll keep you updated as things unfold. You can’t leave that battlefield until each Sunder is back on board our ships.
the-cerberus-hounds:
All Capellan residents are stalwart, hardworking, and deeply honored to live under our flag and the protection it provides. That, however, does not mean we are unaware of the unfortunate constraints and shortcomings our nation has been forced to institute. As the centuries of the Succession Wars have passed, we’ve seen our territory shrink and our military production slowly erode.

One of our military assets is a band of Davion military defectors from the Ninth Avalon Hussars, who fled to our territory in 2862, near the end of the Second Succession War. Disagreeing with the self-righteous hypocrisy of the Federated Suns, these defectors helped Chancellor Otto Liao formulate the "elastic defense" strategy that saved our realm. For the past century and a half, the Cerberus Hounds, as they called themselves, have lived in relative peace in a collection of planets inside Confederation space. As various threats arise, however, the Hounds have been known to answer the call to defend themselves and our great nation.

Now it seems their location and disposition have been leaked to Davion forces, who sent strike teams to eliminate the defectors for their ancestors' generations-old betrayal. As capable as these noble Capellan warriors are, we cannot let them fall in battle. We request any support available. Safeguard our citizens, and you shall be rewarded.

You have protected our loyal citizens thus far, but the fight against our great enemy is far from over. The Davionists will not stop until they are either victorious or utterly destroyed. See to it that you ensure the latter, not the former. Continue to aid us in the fight against our oppressors, and you shall be rewarded.

While you held off the First Kittery Borderers' initial assault, the Cerberus Hounds have evacuated most of their noncombatants, and will be sending you reserves shortly. In the meantime, it is recommended that you lure the Davion troops into the badlands and hold them there as long as possible. You will be provided with maps that should enable you to play an effective game of cat-and-mouse in order to buy you the time needed for the relief force to arrive.
the-conspirators:
Hello, Mercenary.

I am Silvan Vaughn, a representative with "Eyes on Democracy". We're an independent watchdog group that monitors local level democratic elections within the Federated Suns. We have received dire intel that the leading candidate in a regional election for a Trade Federation Presidency position, one Casper Owens, has been targeted in an assassination plot by the lord of the Capellan March, Duke Hasek-Davion. Our sources say that Candidate Owens and Duke Hasek-Davion have had a number of public spats, with Casper Owens openly denouncing Duke Hasek-Davion's rule over the Capellan March. It appears as if the duke wishes to see candidate Owens dead so that his puppet candidate may secure the election.

Eyes on Democracy cannot allow for this to happen. While the Federated Suns' interstellar politics are often dominated by hereditary rulers that serve at the beck and call to their House Lords, how various systems are administered is often left to the discretion of the duke or duchess of each system.  Because of this, a large number of system level administrative positions in the Federation are often filled through elected representatives from the local populace.  With this Trade Federation Presidency serving as a sensitive position that administers JumpShiping routes, commercial Drop Ship cargo processing, and logistical distribution of supplies for multiple systems around the Capellan March. Eyes on Democracy cannot allow for such a sensitive public position to erode into a puppet of our regional March Lord. As it is unlikely that Duke Hasek Davion would allow for that power to return to the people once he secures it.

We would like to contract your mercenary outfit to reinforce our security detail around Casper Owens, and assist us in protecting the integrity of this regional election.  While we have a small contingent of Battlemech forces on hand, we cannot hope to stand against the might that Duke Hasek-Davion can bring if this intelligence ends up being true. The voices of the free people of the Federated Suns needs your expertise, Commander. Will you help us?

Commander,

After interrogating a number of survivors from the attack we have learned the identity of the would-be executioners: The Eighth Syrtis Fusiliers. Part of the Hasek family's private army.

It is as we feared. Duke Hasek-Davion's involvement with the attempt on Candidate Owens is now certain! And the Eyes of Democracy cannot hope to stand against the unified might of the Hasek Family's private army. But with your help, we may be able to occupy their attention enough to ensure they do no further meddling in the upcoming elections.

While the Fusiliers are still licking their wounds, we want you to conduct a raid against the Eighth's regional armory. A successful raid against the infrastructure that supports the Fusiliers should disrupt their operations throughout the region making it impossible for them to mount another assassination attempt against Candidate Owens. For this mission we will not be able to provide you with any assistance. Your mercenary status gives Eyes on Democracy plausible deniability should you fail and we must keep candidate Owen's hands clean from all of this business.

Good luck, Commander.

Commander, I cannot thank you enough for your assistance in this matter.

Unfortunately, the Fusiliers do not appear to be backing down. While the Eighth has fallen back to New Syrtis to regroup and resupply, our Intel has informed us that other Fusilier regiments have been deployed into the region. As the election draws closer, the threat of another assassination attempt becomes larger. What's worse, the next campaign stop for candidate Owens brings him close to a military base garrisoned by elements of the Fifth Syrtis Fusiliers. We are concerned that they may mobilize to make another attempt on candidate Owens' life. This election is drawing too close to risk complacency. The Eyes of Democracy wants you to attack this garrison to ensure that the Fusiliers stations close to the campaign stop does not become a threat.

Don't fail us now, Commander.

Commander,

The election is just around the corner, so this is the final chance that Duke Hasek-Davion has to silence Candidate Owens. Eyes on Democracy intel has uncovered that one Count Anton Vitios is leading the Fusilier's efforts to assassinate candidate Owens on behalf of his lord, Duke Hasek-Davion. We've tracked count Vitios' location to a remote facility high in the mountains ranges of Novaya Zemlya. If we can cut the head off this snake, we can put an end to the Fusiliers attempts against candidate Owens life once and for all.

Given the severity of this mission, my forces and I will be joining you in the field where we will launch a two pronged assault against count Vitios' base of operations. It's risky, but if we can pincer them in, they will have no place to escape to. My forces will attack from the north while you advance on the base from the south along the primary road. Make sure no one escapes.

Be warned: The southern pass leading to count Vitios' base can be treacherous with long sight lines across the chasm. It is advised you bring Battlemechs with long range capabilities on this mission. If we are successful here, Eyes on Democracy will ensure that you are repaid what you are truly owed for your services to our cause.

See you on the other side, Commander.
the-cost-of-freedom: We salute you for fighting valiantly against our cause, but we know your contract with the Archon's loyalist dogs has expired and they are attempting to extend your contract terms. Do not listen to them. We can match what they are offering you, C-Bill for C-Bill. What's more, we can give you a worthy cause to call your own. Join our ranks, stop the attacks, and help secure freedom and a prosperous future of our people. All that we ask is for you to give us a fighting chance to evacuate this planet.
the-cost-of-loyalty:
You've executed a superb defense against superior forces and continue to live up to your growing reputation. However, we know your contract with the Free Skye rebels has expired, and you are now free agents. What's more, the Skye rebellion is over: it's now simply a matter of finding and capturing the remaining traitors before they can fuel future rebellions.

We are offering you a new contract with exceptional terms. Follow the rebels to their current hiding spot, and we will pay you a bounty for each Free Skye member you eliminate. Every rebel you dispatch means one fewer for the LCAF to hunt down later.

The contract awaits your signature.
the-enemy-of-my-enemy: While the Great Houses of Liao and Marik have clashed for centuries, other enemies often force an "enemy of my enemy" détente. SAFE, House Marik's intelligence apparatus, has unearthed a plot where a clandestine Davion strike force—believed to be an ad-hoc detachment of the Lexington Combat Group—has infiltrated Marik space. They plan on invading the Capellan Confederation via the Free Worlds League border, hoping to spark a war between the two nations. Although the League has fought many wars with House Liao, the Confederation serves as a useful buffer between the League and the much stronger House Davion. As such, House Marik wants to hire you to destroy the Davion strike force in secret: if the truth is revealed, House Liao may not trust the situation, and war may ensue regardless.

Our SAFE agents have learned that the Lexington Combat Group is furious at your interference. We believe they are now planning a retaliatory attack on a Free Worlds League system. You are to defend the targeted settlement by any means necessary.

We thank you for your aid in ending this threat to our nation. Nevertheless, the situation continues to develop. SAFE has uncovered disturbing but unsubstantiated findings that point to House Davion's complete lack of involvement in the Lexington Combat Group's hiring. Our trail of breadcrumbs now points to overzealous elements within the Fusiliers of Oriente's Fourth Brigade, provincial FWLM troops who are desperate to destroy House Liao. To this end, it is believed that the leadership of the Fourth worked with a local colony of fanatics to stage the LCG's initial strike against the Capellan Confederation and arrange House Davion's culpability. The political ramifications for sending federal FWLM troops against provincial troops from the Duchy of Oriente without ironclad evidence or Parliamentary approval cannot be overstated. Until we can sort out the politics of this situation, a careful watch will be placed on the Fourth. In the interim, you must strike at this colony of anti-Liao fanatics, eliminating any on-world forces and making an example of such zealotry.

Attacks still continue on both sides, as each nation conducts regular intelligence-gathering raids across the border. However, the raids are increasing in intensity and frequency of late.

It's speculated these false-flag operations are an attempt to drive our two Houses back into all-out war.

Your contract is to garrison two planets where a future attack is expected, and hopefully you can eliminate this threat to both Great Houses.

the-only-truth-that-sticks:
Candace Liao's illegal annexation of the St. Ives Commonality was a betrayal of the highest order! She has brought shame to her father, Chancellor Liao, and with it, the entirety of the Confederation! The treachery of her and those that abandoned the Confederation in its time of need will never be forgiven by the Capellan people until all those involved are brought to justice!

Candace believes herself and her new husband safe in the walls of her petty little puppet state. But her sister, Romano Liao, has devised a plan to remind Candace of the tenuous position she put herself in when she abandoned the Confederation, by crippling one of her St. Ives Compact's units. Her cherished St. Ives Sentinels.

We're asking you to join with the Second Confederation Reserve Cavalry in staging a raid that will coax out her St. Ives Sentinels into an ambush. Crippling the Sentinels will show those traitors that the Confederation will seek justice for its people and their masters within the Federated Commonwealth will do nothing to protect them! We will have justice on behalf of the Confederation!

We have taken the primary interplanetary communications array located on Vestallas III. At the moment, the St. Ives Sentinels have yet to move from their garrison on Vestallas IV. In order for Romano's plan to work, the St. Ives Compact must be completely unaware of our machinations. There are still a few liabilities, particularly in the form of a robust network of satellite arrays in Wong Tai Sin City. We're deploying you to hit the ground and destroy the communications technology so the ambush can proceed. The Second Confederation Reserve Cavalry will execute similar raids in other parts of the system. See that this gets done, Commander.

Alright Commander, the communications are disabled and the ambush is set. All that remains is to execute the plan.

We've issued a false flag statement to Vestallas III that pirates have raided the system and have taken control of a number of munitions armories here on the planet hoping to make a play for Jinshan, The Golden Mountain. A series of underground vaults on Vestallas IV that contains a large portion of the Confederation's state treasures stolen by the Compact. The Sentinels have sent only a small portion of their forces to chase these supposed pirates off while the rest of the Sentinels continue to guard the Golden Mountain.

Little do they know that, for now, we are not after the stolen wealth of our people. We are here to bring vengeance on those who abandoned us in our time of need. When the Sentinels land here thinking that only a lowly band of pirates are present, they will face our glorious wrath! Now is time for you to join the ambush and punish Candace for her sins of abandoning her father and her people to lick the boots of the Davion Imperialists!
the-powder-keg:
Hello Mercenary, I hope this message reaches you well. You can call me Miller. My job is to connect organizations who have problems with Mercenary companies who are capable of solving them. Think of me as a sort of broker.

I am contacting you on behalf of a benefactor who wishes to remain anonymous. They are looking for an independent mercenary unit to strike key strategic targets within this region. Curiously enough, the targets are both of Steiner and Kuritan ownership. I'm not aware of their exact motives, but if I was to hazard a guess, they are looking to incite conflict between the two sides, hoping your attacks will trigger open war. You will be rewarded handsomely if you can live with this contract's moral... shortcomings.

Good work, 'Merc.

Our benefactor is quite pleased with your performance, and are willing to forward you the information for their next target. While last time you hit the Steiner base, it seems now that they have a Kuritan target in mind. The planet Port Moseby appears to be a fairly nondescript agricultural world, but it turns out that the Draconis Combine is secretly using it as a comms relay planet to monitor the frontline. It truly does seem like your shadow-employer is looking to ignite war in this volatile region...

Interesting development, 'Merc.

I've theorized that this shadow client is paying you to attack strategic targets along the Kurita/Steiner border to trigger war. Turns out, they want the opposite.

The targets you've been attacking have been crippling each side's military infrastructure, and doing so has reduced the likelyhood of fighting boiling over. By hiring a third party, the benefactor hopes that the factions' ire is directed to you. Unfortunately a Steiner general has unearthed this plot and is none too happy. Turns out he's an old-guard war monger, and is looking for any excuse to go to battle. You'll need to silence the general before the plot boils over.
the-shadow-coup: We represent a small group of anonymous Lyran military leaders, and all of us are fed up with the ineffectual leadership of high-ranking Steiner officers who have been promoted into their roles solely due to networking and social connections. Our superiors recently ordered several disastrous and irresponsible raids that resulted in dozens of unnecessary deaths among various Lyran Guards detachments. It's time now to act. We are providing you intel on two targets we'd like you to "take care of." One struts around in his overly equipped BattleMech, while the other spends most of his days in his office at the unit's headquarters, making flippant decisions that get good Lyran soldiers killed.

Greetings from the Lagom-gumi. You may be surprised to hear from a yakuza organization from Rasalhaguian planets, but I assure you we can be found on nearly every system the Draconis Combine once controlled. Now, before you rashly reject our offer, pay no heed to those who would paint us as criminals. Regardless of our organization's dealings, all yakuza gumi share a deep, cultural tradition: our ultimate loyalty lies with our local community. When calamity strikes, we are foremost among those who provide aid and disaster relief to the people we and our leadership have sworn to protect. Perhaps knowing our true aims will help you decide to work with us.

In the interest of preventing disaster before it can strike our community, the oyabun of the Lagom-gumi seeks to hire you to defend the planets under our protection.

the-traitor:
A once-noble MechWarrior marched into battle under the flag of the Draconis Combine. This warrior represented the best of Kuritan ideals, bringing honor, loyalty, and courage onto the battlefield.

Unfortunately this warrior has abandoned the bushido code. Not only did they lose their way, they corrupted other sons and daughters of the Dragon with their false promises of Davion protection. These defectors have crossed the enemy border and are currently beyond our reach, but they are not beyond yours. Two star systems house known Kurita defectors. We request that you raid both worlds and purge them of the cowards.

The arm of the Dragon's justice is long, and your cooperation shall extend its reach even farther.

those-in-need:
Greetings Commander.  

You may call us the Independent People of Skye.  We represent a number of units under the employ of House Steiner currently assigned to the front line against House Kurita. 

In 3023, House Steiner shocked the entire Inner Sphere with the creation of the first new 'Mech design in generations, the Hatchetman. The Archon said that this new 'Mech would help bolster our country's 'Mech regiments with a new line 'Mech.  But in reality, the 'Mech has mostly been distributed to forces loyal to the Archon, and those warmongering pigs in the Federated Suns. Doing nothing for those of us in the Isle of Skye as our home defenses are slowly whittled down every day by raiders from the Draconis Combine. 
We've learned that the Archon and Defiance Industries have delivered an entire company of new Hatchetmen 'Mechs to the Nineteenth Arcturan Guards. A formerly prestigious unit before they incurred major losses at the hands of House Kurita decades ago.

While this may sound like a legitimate reason to refit the unit with new 'Mechs, I assure you it is not.  In the decades since their collapse, the Nineteenth has become a dumping ground for the spoiled sons and daughters of the Commonwealth's wealthiest families entering the LCAF.  Riding high on the coattails of the Nineteenth's storied past to further elevate their own social status while turning the unit itself into their own state sponsored frat house. 

As the first brand new 'Mech designed in over a century, the Hatchetman has become a hot commodity that the Archon is willing to throw these petulant brats in order to appease their wealthy industrialist parents rather than supporting those of us on the front lines who are in desperate need of new equipment to fight our actual enemies! I wish we had a better way of doing this, but we are left with no more options.  We want your unit to disable as many of these Hatchetmen as possible so that we may take possession of them. 

We can't overtly move against our own countrymen, but we are in desperate need of those 'Mechs to defend ourselves from Kuritan aggression. So we're seeking your aid in capturing and acquiring these Hatchetmen and putting them in the hands of the people that truly need them.  

Will you help us?
Good work Commander. 

We were able to recover all four of the Hatchetmen that your lance destroyed.  But their battle damage is significant.  In order to get them operational, we will need to collect a large supply of replacement parts.

We've identified a series of locations where the Arcturan Guards have stored replacement actuators, myomer bundles, and weapons systems for the Hatchetmen.  We'll need to conduct an objective raid to find and recover these supplies in order to repair the lance of Hatchetmen you've captured for us. 

We'll highlight locations in which the supplies should be located, but it will be up to you and your lance to identify and recover any materials on-site.  All further tactical information has been forwarded over to Ryana.  Good hunting Commander. 
Commander,

The Independent People of Skye have come to learn that Tobias Klein is stationed here on Benfled with the Arcturan Guards. Tobias is the eldest son of Emma Klein, who sits on the Defiance Industries board of directors. We believe that Tobias' current station may be the reason Defiance and the Archon have shown such clear favoritism towards the Arcturan Guards.

We're tasking your lance with finding Tobias and his Catapult and destroying it. Even if Tobias survives the encounter, the destruction of his family's 'Mech should show to his mother that the Arcturan Guards are undeserving of such preferential treatment. 
Commander, 

Your performance up to this point has been exemplary.  But we fear that your efficiency might make our objectives here too transparent to the outside observer.  This could potentially lead to the Arcturan Guards identifying our organization. Which is something we cannot risk. 

For our own safety, we'll need to throw the Guards off of our trail by attacking a military target making this entire endeavor appear more as a clandestine military raid.  We've identified a remote outpost that contains the Arcturan Guards back-up data center.  Destroying this facility won't be enough to compromise Benfled's security, but should be enough for our actions here to appear that our objectives here were the destruction of this data center and not the systematic strikes against the Arcturan Guards themselves.  
Commander, 

Before we release you from your contract, we have one final assignment from you.  We want to give the Arcturan Guards one final gesture of "up yours" before we return home. My people have put in anonymous tips through the local law enforcement reporting "Kuritan 'Mechs" held up in what is known locally as "The Heap." 

Once upon a time, it was a Star League era metropolis. But WarShips obliterated it through orbital bombardments during the early Succession Wars.  In the hundreds of years since, the city's ruins have become a massive dumping ground for all of Benfled's waste.  Everything from the trash of the major population centers to industrial waste disposal. It all ends up here among the ruins of the old world. 

After handing them a pair of embarrassing defeats, the Arcturan Guards will be forced to investigate this tip.  Which means that they will be conveniently suckered into a spot where it should be easy enough for you to pick them apart.  We'll leave these spoiled jackasses buried in Benfled's trash. Right where all of them belong.  

Afterwards we'll release the remainder of your contracted payments and then we'll go our separate ways.
thumb-war:
Commander, 

Archon Katherine Steiner-Davion seeks to reinforce the recently coined Lyons Thumb region of the Chaos March. As you may be aware, she has claimed the world of Lyons for the Lyran Alliance. While the Lyons Thumb region lies coreward of Terra, it extends into the Draconis Combine. Our intelligence indicates that Coordinator Theodore Kurita, with the support of Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht and Primus Sharilar Mori, has deployed an estimated nine DCMS units under nominal ComStar authority to maintain order.

Although the Archon has publicly welcomed these Kuritan “peacekeepers,” she does not believe their mandate is legitimate. She views this move as a calculated attempt to annex the Thumb. To avoid the appearance of direct Lyran aggression, she has authorized the use of mercenary forces to act on her behalf and apply pressure to the DCMS presence in the region.

We have identified a sector on the outskirts of Lyons with a manageable enemy presence. If you accept, your objective will be to harass and drive Kuritan forces out of the area, sending a clear message that further expansion into the Lyons Thumb will not be tolerated. We await your response.

Commander,

I just received an updated movement report in the Thumb. It appears the DCMS forces in nearby regions are not yet mobilizing. So it appears they feel they can contain this threat right now. We have detected multiple Kuritan signatures that have just activated, so they’re clearly preparing to put a lid on this right now.

I have gotten a read on this DCMS regiment that’s spooling up. These dragons are veterans with a lot of blood on their record; you take out these targets, and that will capture their attention. It will be interesting to see what their next move on the chessboard will be after that. There’s no way to do this quietly now, Commander. Go make some noise.

Commander,

Radar shows the DCMS reinforcements are about to hit your position. No use drawing this out. They are going to band together with their comrades and try hold this ground. It looks like they are fanning out to try to divide and conquer. They’ll be sitting back and waiting for you to come to them, so try not to let any of their forces bog you down. I need you to secure every inch of this ground. We need Theodore Kurita to see his after-action reports and start re-thinking the DCMS occupation here.  Go deal with the remaining Kuritans and help craft that message.
tributes-for-the-imperator:
Commander, I hope this message finds you well.

A former Free Worlds League aligned mercenary company known as the El Giza Ghost Riders got on the bad side of the Mercenary Review Board after they abandoned their contract with the League. The FWLM has issued arrest warrants for the Ghost Riders on charges of dereliction of duty, while the MRB has imposed sanctions on the unit barring them from any future work. Unwilling to surrender to the League and unable to take on any MRB-backed work, the unit attempted to take refuge in the Marian Hegemony.

In exchange for clemency, the Hegemony has demanded that the unit must provide tribute to the Marian dictator, Imperator Marius O'Reilly. Unfortunately, that tribute comes in the form of raiding our star systems. We just received word from Bethonolog that the unit has jumped into the system, demanding the militia stand down or be crushed under their boot. We don't know what the militia will do, but we doubt that they will be able to hold back the Ghost Riders for long.

We're preparing to deploy the First Canopian Fusiliers to deal with this rabble, but they have requested that we enlist mercenary support to supplement their forces. We're formally asking you to come aboard, help establish a beachhead for the Canopian Fusiliers, and assist them in wiping out all Ghost Rider forces.

You've done good work, but the El Giza Ghost Riders are massing for an assault against our forces. The First Canopian Fusiliers want to minimize collateral damage to our infrastructure, so they will be moving to engage the Ghost Riders in the field. We'll need you to join the Fusiliers and strike back against the raiders. But be careful, the Ghost Riders must be truly desperate if they are resorting to piracy. That will make them unpredictable.

The Ghost Riders have almost broken, and it's up to you to finish them off. Our remaining forces are dispersing to re-secure our citizens and infrastructure, so we're tasking you with hunting down the last of the Ghost Rider leadership for termination. Such a decisive blow should be enough to send whatever remains of these outlaws back to the stars.
uprising-quelled:
This message is sent on behalf of Duchess Karis So, ruler of the Sarna Commonality's Duchy of Tsitsang:

"As the representative of the duchy, I vouch for my constituents day in and day out. Over the last few years, the local residents have grown restless and insolent, despite my steady rule, and the people have been frequently calling for appeals to any political issue I weigh in on. The Duchy of Tsitsang is my hereditary fiefdom, having been in my family for centuries. Despite my ability to overrule any of my people’s requests, it breaks my heart to see them question my judgment.

"I want you to enforce my will on a particularly prickly world. The people need a reminder of what I am capable of and what it means to be obedient to me, and thus to the Celestial Wisdom, may he live forever.

"The rebels in question have taken up arms on the world of Bora. As all good Capellan citizens know, in 2366 the leaders of the Duchy of Liao, Tikonov Grand Union, Sarna Supremacy, Capellan Commonality, Sian Commonwealth, and St. Ives Mercantile League met on this world to form our beloved Capellan Confederation. We cannot allow the rebels to pervert this symbolism. As a concrete example of the wages of disobedience, I would ask you to locate the rebels' base and raze it to the ground."

x-marks-the-spot:
Commander, as you know, Interstellar Expeditions relies on independent contractors such as yourself to guarantee the safety of our core personnel in IE's various pursuits. This sometimes means that we must rely on less scrupulous members of society in order to get our work done. No place is this more true than in our dealings in the Deep Periphery where it is often more reliable to simply payoff local pirate groups for protection then risk raids against various excavation sites.

One such group that operates in the Lyran Commonwealth's Deep Periphery and the Barrens has recently seen themselves dragged into a conflict with the Oberon Confederation. A conflict that they are currently losing. Interstellar Expeditions feels that it is in our best interest to provide assistance to our privateer partners in order to prevent information regarding our involvement with the group from reaching the ears of the Oberon Confederation. We would like to contract your outfit to join this pirate group as new recruits and assist them in a series of re-supply raids in Commonwealth space to better prepare themselves to stand up against the Oberon Confederation.

As an initiation test, they would like you to perform an objective raid against a series of House Steiner logistical facilities within the region.

Looks like you passed the first trial, Commander. Regas is excited to see what else you can do. He already has another raiding job lined up for you, and I imagine this one is going to be tougher. The coordinates they sent us are near a military outpost, so it's a good bet you will be looking for weapons and ammo to outfit the pirates.

So far so good, Commander. Regas is definitely impressed. I bet many pirate recruits don't make it this far. It sounds like he has one more task for you in order to show dedication to the pirate cause. Regas wants you to take out a communications station in order to provide cover for his smuggling run operation. Be careful, it's sure to be heavily defended.

Yaros seems delighted! He has invited you to join him for a parlay and he has sent another set of coordinates, Commander. Looks like they're for a distant moon. Scouting reports indicate that there's a small base there. It could be a pirate compound or storage facility of some kind. It seems like you have earned his trust.
